content.title: DJT Stock Is Falling. Why Short Sellers Are Circling Trump Media.
content.summary: Trump Media & Technology Group  stock was under pressure early Thursday.  Short sellers have increased their bets against the company, perhaps indicating that some investors may remain unconvinced by its recent merger with a nuclear fusion group.  Trump Media, which trades under the ticker  DJT  in reference to President Donald Trump’s initials, announced a merger last month with nuclear fusion firm TAE Technologies, driving its shares up by more than 40 per cent on the day of the announcement.

content.title: Trump Media Looks for Sites for First Nuclear-Fusion Power Plant
content.summary: Trump Media & Technology Group and fusion firm TAE Technologies are looking for sites for a fusion power plant.  Trump Media Chief Executive Devin Nunes said the company is “actively holding discussions with multiple states and entities about potential sites.”  Trump Media is majority owned by President Trump and owns his Truth Social platform.
